title: Deconvolution
description: Widefield and confocal 3D deconvolution: Richardson-Lucy, optionally with total-variation regularisation, with a Gibson-Lanni or measured PSF.

deconvolve.title: Deconvolve stack
deconvolve.description: Deconvolve one single-channel 3D microscopy stack with a theoretical Gibson-Lanni PSF for the given optics, or with a measured PSF, and return the deconvolved stack as TIFF and NIfTI with the PSF used.

image.description: One single-channel 3D stack: TIFF, OME-TIFF, ImageJ TIFF or NIfTI

psf.description: Optional measured PSF (a bead stack) on the image's voxel size; replaces the theoretical PSF

modality.description: Widefield (emission PSF) or confocal (excitation × emission PSF, pinhole much smaller than one Airy unit)

numericalAperture.description: Objective numerical aperture, below the immersion index

immersionIndex.description: Refractive index of the immersion medium (1.0 air, 1.333 water, 1.518 oil)

sampleIndex.description: Refractive index of the sample or mounting medium; matters only with a depth above 0

depthUm.description: Depth of the imaged plane below the coverslip in micrometres, for refractive-index mismatch

voxelSizeXYUm.description: Lateral voxel size in micrometres; overrides the file's calibration

voxelSizeZUm.description: Axial voxel size in micrometres; overrides the file's calibration

method.description: rl: Richardson-Lucy as scikit-image; rltv: with total-variation regularisation (Dey et al. 2006)
